headline: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
summary: X is ending its existing content creator revenue-sharing program. A new 'Original Content Rewards' program will launch on September 8th. Eligibility requires 500+ verified followers and 500,000+ verified Home Timeline impressions.

headline: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
summary: Amazon is funding a new power plant for its West Texas data center. The new gas-burning plant could become the largest single producer of greenhouse gases in the US. Critics raise environmental concerns over Amazon's energy investment.

headline: Buc-ee’s dodges John Oliver to sue another small business
summary: Buc-ee's, known for suing small businesses over branding, recently avoided John Oliver's on-air challenge. Instead of suing Oliver, the company is now suing another small convenience store. Oliver's segment highlighted Buc-ee's aggressive legal tactics.

headline: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is building a digital music player, but don’t call it retro
summary: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is developing a new digital music player. He aims to create a modern device focused on unique music experiences, not nostalgia. Vek, known for his indietronica, emphasizes innovation over retro design.

headline: Mortal Kombat Director 'Not Sure' About Return for Third Movie as Mortal Kombat 3 Remains in Limbo
summary: Mortal Kombat movie director Simon McQuoid has expressed uncertainty about returning for a third film. Work on 'Mortal Kombat 3' currently remains in limbo. McQuoid's potential absence casts doubt on the franchise's cinematic future.

headline: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Opening Permanent Location Featuring Animatronic Stage Shows in 2027
summary: A permanent Freddy Fazbear's Pizza location is set to open in 2027. This venture is a collaboration between Five Nights at Freddy's and entertainment hub American Dream. The location will feature animatronic stage shows, bringing the game to life.

headline: 'They Fundamentally Don't Understand Art' — Doom Dev Blasts Xbox After Microsoft 'Gutted' id Software With Layoffs
summary: A Doom developer, Chris Hays, criticized Xbox following recent layoffs at id Software. Hays stated that Xbox "fundamentally don't understand art." The layoffs at the iconic gaming studio occurred in July.

headline: The Best Deals Today: AirPods Pro 3, LEGO Back to the Future, Saros, and More
summary: Discover today's top deals on popular tech and entertainment items. Find discounts on products like AirPods Pro 3. Explore savings opportunities on LEGO Back to the Future sets and other featured items.

headline: Andy Burnham to embark on cost of living tour through the UK
summary: Andy Burnham is set to begin a UK tour focused on the cost of living crisis. No 10 claims the prime minister's plans will "give people some room to breathe." Opposition figures accuse the government of "hypocrisy."

headline: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
summary: Fifa has strongly criticized what it calls a "concerted and ongoing effort" to "undermine" the organization. The football body is defending its president, Gianni Infantino, against opposition. Fifa alleges a campaign to oust its leadership.

headline: Killed a month after his wedding - why PC Andrew Harper's death touched so many
summary: The death of PC Andrew Harper, a month after his wedding, deeply resonated with the public. The case is back in the spotlight due to the early release of two of his killers. His story continues to highlight public demand for justice.

headline: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
summary: Israel is facing accusations of using archaeology as a tool for land expropriation in the West Bank. Plans involve large-scale land seizures in historic Palestinian areas. Critics argue these actions politically weaponize cultural heritage.
